measures.name: average_minutes_per_day
measures.description: Σ(w·minutes)/Σ(w): average minutes per day across the whole selected population, participants and non-participants alike.

measures.name: participation_rate
measures.description: Σ(w·participant)/Σ(w): share of the population doing the activity on an average day (a proportion 0-1; a daily rate, not a longer-period one).

measures.name: average_minutes_per_participant
measures.description: Σ(w·minutes)/Σ(w·participant): average minutes per day among those who did the activity that day.

measures.name: participants_per_day
measures.description: Σ(w·participant)/days: number of persons doing the activity on an average day of the period.

weight_schemes.name: multiyear
weight_schemes.description: BLS multi-year weight, comparable across years.

weight_schemes.name: pandemic
weight_schemes.description: 2020-method weight representing the collection-comparable windows Jan 1-Mar 17 and May 10-Dec 31.

unsupported: episode-context analyses (location, time of day, who was present)
ATUS module data (Eating & Health, Well-Being, Leave) and module weights
significance tests (estimates, SEs, and CIs only)
